title: "ICEMAN online tool"
toc: false

```{=html}
<style>
.tab-btns { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.tab-btn {
  padding:8px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #ced4da;
  background:transparent; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:500;
  transition:all 0.15s;
}
.tab-btn.active { background:#3B2140; color:#fff; border-color:#3B2140; }
.tab-pane { display:none; }
.tab-pane.active { display:block; }

.iceman-item {
  border:1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius:10px;
  padding:1.25rem 1.25rem 1rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; background:#fff;
}
.item-num {
  font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; color:#3B2140;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; margin-bottom:0.2rem;
}
.item-q { font-weight:600; font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:0.3rem; }
.item-hint { font-size:0.84rem; color:#666; margin-bottom:1rem; line-height:1.5; }
.manual-link {
  font-size:0.72rem; color:#3B2140; text-decoration:none;
  border:1px solid #3B2140; border-radius:4px; padding:1px 7px; margin-left:8px;
}
.manual-link:hover { background:#DCEEF6; }

.radio-row {
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;
  padding:8px 10px; border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid transparent; margin-bottom:4px; transition:all 0.1s;
}
.radio-row:hover { background:#F4EFF6; border-color:#D9CFDE; }
.radio-row.selected { background:#DCEEF6; border-color:#3B2140; }
.radio-row input[type=radio] { margin-top:3px; flex-shrink:0; }
.rl { font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; }
.rl-red    { color:#c0392b; }
.rl-orange { color:#d35400; }
.rl-yellow { color:#9a7d0a; }
.rl-green  { color:#1a7a4a; }
.rd { font-size:0.82rem; color:#666; }

.cred-wrap { position:relative; margin:0.75rem 0 0.25rem; }
.cred-bar {
  height:10px; border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,#c0392b 0%,#e67e22 25%,#F0C800 55%,#F0C800 70%,#1D9E75 84%,#1a7a4a 100%);
}
.cred-labels {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; margin-top:5px; text-align:center;
}
.cred-labels span:nth-child(1) { color:#c0392b; }
.cred-labels span:nth-child(2) { color:#d35400; }
.cred-labels span:nth-child(3) { color:#9a7d0a; }
.cred-labels span:nth-child(4) { color:#1a7a4a; }
.cred-thumb {
  position:absolute; top:50%; width:18px; height:18px;
  border-radius:50%; background:#fff; border:2px solid #333;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%); pointer-events:none; transition:left 0.05s;
}
input.cred-slider {
  width:100%; position:relative; z-index:2;
  opacity:0; cursor:pointer; height:24px; margin-top:-17px; display:block;
}
.scale-interp { text-align:left; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:#333; margin-top:0.6rem; }

textarea.comment-box {
  width:100%; margin-top:10px; font-size:0.84rem;
  padding:7px 10px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid #dee2e6;
  resize:vertical; min-height:48px; background:#f8f9fa;
}

.result-section {
  border:1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius:10px;
  padding:1.5rem; margin-top:1.5rem; background:#fff;
}
.result-row {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  padding:6px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0; font-size:0.875rem;
}
.result-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.b-0  { background:#FDEAEA; color:#c0392b; font-size:0.73rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; }
.b-1  { background:#FEF0E6; color:#d35400; font-size:0.73rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; }
.b-2  { background:#FDFAE6; color:#9a7d0a; font-size:0.73rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; }
.b-3  { background:#E6F5EE; color:#1a7a4a; font-size:0.73rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; }
.b-na { background:#f0f0f0; color:#666;    font-size:0.73rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap; }

.verdict-box {
  text-align:center; padding:1.5rem; margin-top:1rem;
  border-radius:8px; background:#f8f9fa; border:1px solid #dee2e6;
}
.verdict-label { font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; }
.verdict-sub   { font-size:0.88rem; color:#555; margin-top:5px; }

.live-summary {
  border:1px solid #c5d8ef; border-radius:10px;
  padding:1.25rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; background:#f4f8fd;
}
.live-summary-title {
  font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; color:#3B2140;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; margin-bottom:0.75rem;
}
.summary-row {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;
  padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dde8f5; gap:12px; font-size:0.875rem;
}
.summary-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.s-label { color:#333; flex:1; }
.s-comment { font-size:0.78rem; color:#777; margin-top:2px; font-style:italic; }

.prelim-grid { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin-bottom:1rem; }
.field-label-row { display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px; }
.field-label-row label { margin-bottom:0; }
.tip-trigger {
  font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; color:#3B2140; cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid #3B2140; border-radius:50%;
  width:18px; height:18px; padding:0; line-height:1;
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:transparent; flex-shrink:0; margin-left:8px;
}
.tip-trigger:hover { background:#DCEEF6; }
#tip-card {
  display:none; position:fixed; z-index:9999;
  background:#fff; border:1px solid #c5d8ef; border-radius:10px;
  padding:1rem; max-width:320px; width:320px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
  font-size:0.84rem; line-height:1.6; color:#333;
}
.tip-card-link {
  display:block; margin-top:0.75rem; font-size:0.78rem;
  color:#3B2140; text-decoration:none;
  border-top:1px solid #dee2e6; padding-top:0.75rem;
}
.tip-card-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
.fgroup { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; }
.fgroup label { font-size:0.82rem; color:#555; font-weight:600; }
.fgroup input, .fgroup select, .fgroup textarea {
  font-size:0.9rem; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:7px;
  border:1px solid #dee2e6; background:#f8f9fa; color:inherit; width:100%;
}
.action-row { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.btn-tool { padding:9px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #ced4da; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:500; background:#fff; }
.btn-tool.primary { background:#3B2140; color:#fff; border-color:#3B2140; }
.btn-tool.primary:hover { background:#2A1730; }
.btn-tool:hover { background:#F4EFF6; }
.stopped-msg { background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffc107; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.25rem; margin-top:1rem; font-size:0.9rem; }
.field-invalid { border:2px solid #c0392b !important; background:#fff8f8 !important; }
.item-invalid { border-color:#c0392b !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #fdeaea; }
.item-auto-na { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }
.comment-warn { border:2px solid #e67e22 !important; background:#fffaf5 !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(230,126,34,0.15); }
.inline-warn { background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffc107; border-radius:8px; padding:0.75rem 1rem; margin:0.75rem 0; font-size:0.875rem; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:0.5rem; }
.inline-warn button { background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:1.1rem; color:#888; padding:0; flex-shrink:0; line-height:1; }
.no-warn { display:none; background:#fef3cd; border:1px solid #e6a817; border-left:4px solid #e6a817; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; padding:0.85rem 1rem; margin-top:0.75rem; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.55; color:#5a3e00; }
.no-warn a { color:#3B2140; }
.exc-note { display:none; background:#EEF7FB; border:1px solid #A9D0E1; border-left:4px solid #79AEC5; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; padding:0.85rem 1rem; margin-top:0.75rem; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.55; color:#2B3A42; }
.exc-note a { color:#3B2140; }
#val-modal { display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45); z-index:10000; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
#val-modal.open { display:flex; }
#val-modal-box { background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem 1.75rem; max-width:400px; width:90%; border-top:4px solid #c0392b; }
#val-modal-box h3 { margin:0 0 0.5rem; font-size:1rem; color:#c0392b; }
#val-modal-box p { margin:0 0 1.25rem; font-size:0.88rem; color:#444; line-height:1.6; }
#val-modal-box button { padding:7px 22px; border-radius:7px; background:#c0392b; color:#fff; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:600; }
.algo-result  { margin:0.75rem 0; padding:0.75rem 1rem; border-radius:8px; background:#e6f5ee; border:1px solid #a8d5bc; font-size:0.84rem; }
.algo-blocked { margin:0.75rem 0; padding:0.75rem 1rem; border-radius:8px; background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffc107; font-size:0.84rem; }
.algo-counts  { font-size:0.78rem; color:#555; margin-top:4px; }
.algo-shift   { font-size:0.78rem; color:#666; margin-top:2px; font-style:italic; }
.scale-click-hint {
  font-size:0.84rem; color:#888;
}
.study-type-chooser { margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
.study-type-chooser .field-label-row { margin-bottom:0.5rem; }

/* Sticky rating bar */
#sticky-bar {
  display:none; position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:1000;
  background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #dee2e6;
  box-shadow:0 -2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  padding:0.6rem 1.5rem; justify-content:center; align-items:center;
}
#sticky-bar.visible { display:flex; }
.sb-outer { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.75rem; }
.sb-side { font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; width:90px; }
.sb-left { text-align:right; }
.sb-right { text-align:left; }
.sb-bar-wrap { width:220px; flex-shrink:0; position:relative; cursor:pointer; }
.sb-bar {
  height:7px; border-radius:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,#c0392b 0%,#e67e22 25%,#F0C800 55%,#F0C800 70%,#1D9E75 84%,#1a7a4a 100%);
}
.sb-thumb {
  position:absolute; top:50%; width:14px; height:14px;
  border-radius:50%; background:#fff; border:2px solid #333;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%); pointer-events:none;
  transition:left 0.05s;
}
</style>


<div id="sticky-bar">
  <div class="sb-outer">
    <span class="sb-side sb-left" id="sb-left"></span>
    <div class="sb-bar-wrap" id="sb-bar-wrap" onclick="sbClick(event)">
      <div class="sb-bar"></div>
      <div class="sb-thumb" id="sb-thumb" style="left:37.5%"></div>
    </div>
    <span class="sb-side sb-right" id="sb-right"></span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="study-type-chooser">
  <div class="field-label-row">
    <label style="font-weight:600;font-size:1rem">Study type</label>
    <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="study-type">?</button>
  </div>
  <div class="tab-btns" style="margin-bottom:0">
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('rct',this)">Randomized controlled trial (RCT)</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('meta',this)">Meta-analysis / Systematic review</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════════ RCT TAB ══════════════════════ -->
<div id="tab-rct" class="tab-pane">

<div class="iceman-item">
  <div class="item-num">Preliminary considerations</div>
  <div class="prelim-grid">
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Effect modifier</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="modifier">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="r-mod">
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Was the effect modifier measured before or at randomization?</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="prerando">?</button>
      </div>
      <select id="r-prerando">
        <option value="">Select…</option>
        <option value="yes">Yes, continue</option>
        <option value="exception">No, but an exception applies (see user manual)</option>
        <option value="no">No, stop here and refer to user manual</option>
      </select>
      <div id="r-prerando-exc" class="exc-note">
        <strong>Exception:</strong> ICEMAN still applies to an effect modifier measured after randomization if it is a non-modifiable characteristic such as sex or age. <a href="manual/preliminary.html#prelim-prerando" target="iceman-manual">See user manual →</a>
      </div>
      <div id="r-prerando-warn" class="no-warn">
        <strong>Note:</strong> ICEMAN applies to effect modifiers measured before or at randomization. If the effect modifier was measured after randomization (e.g. an intermediate outcome), the analysis of effect modification is complicated and potentially misleading, and requires different methods not covered by ICEMAN. <a href="manual/preliminary.html#prelim-prerando" target="iceman-manual">See user manual for further instructions →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Outcome and time-point</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="outcome">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="r-outcome">
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Effect measure</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="measure">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="r-measure">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="fgroup" style="margin-bottom:0.75rem">
    <div class="field-label-row">
      <label>Does the analysis suggest a possible effect modification (interaction p ≤ 0.1)?</label>
      <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="possible">?</button>
    </div>
    <select id="r-possible">
      <option value="">Select…</option>
      <option value="yes">Yes</option>
      <option value="no">No, stop here</option>
    </select>
    <div id="r-no-warn" class="no-warn">
      <strong>Note:</strong> ICEMAN was developed to assess the credibility of a <em>suggested</em> effect modification (interaction p ≤ 0.1). It does not apply when there is no suggestion of effect modification. Assessing the credibility of an <em>absence</em> of effect modification requires a different approach not covered by ICEMAN. <a href="manual/concepts.html" target="iceman-manual">See user manual for scope of ICEMAN →</a>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div id="r-items">

<div id="r-item-cards"></div>

<div class="live-summary" id="r-live-summary">
  <div class="live-summary-title">Summary of responses</div>
  <div class="s-label" style="color:#888;font-size:0.84rem;">— Fill in the items above to see a summary —</div>
</div>

<div class="iceman-item">
  <div class="item-num">Overall rating</div>
  <div class="item-q">How would you rate the overall credibility of the proposed effect modification? <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip-type="overall" data-item-prefix="r">?</button></div>
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0.5rem 0 0.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button class="btn-tool" onclick="applyComputedRating('r')">Generate rating from responses</button>
    <span class="scale-click-hint">Click scale to rate manually</span>
    <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip-type="generate" data-item-prefix="r">?</button>
  </div>
  <div id="r-algo-result" style="display:none"></div>
  <div class="cred-wrap" id="r-cred-wrap">
    <div class="cred-bar" id="r-cred-bar" onclick="activateScale('r', event)" style="cursor:pointer">
      <div class="cred-thumb" id="r-thumb" style="left:37.5%;display:none"></div>
    </div>
    <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="37.5" class="cred-slider" id="r-scale" oninput="onSliderDrag('r')" style="pointer-events:none">
    <div class="cred-labels"><span>Very low</span><span>Low</span><span>Moderate</span><span>High</span></div>
    <div class="scale-interp" id="r-interp" style="display:none"></div>
  </div>
  <textarea class="comment-box" id="r-overallc" placeholder="Justify your overall rating…"></textarea>
</div>

<div class="action-row">
  <button class="btn-tool primary" onclick="genDocx('r')">Download Word (.docx)</button>
  <button class="btn-tool" onclick="resetForm('r')">Reset form</button>
</div>
<div id="r-report"></div>

</div><!-- end r-items -->
</div><!-- end tab-rct -->

<!-- ══════════════════════ META TAB ══════════════════════ -->
<div id="tab-meta" class="tab-pane">

<div class="iceman-item">
  <div class="item-num">Preliminary considerations</div>
  <div class="prelim-grid">
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Effect modifier</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="modifier">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="m-mod">
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Was the effect modifier measured before or at randomization?</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="prerando">?</button>
      </div>
      <select id="m-prerando">
        <option value="">Select…</option>
        <option value="yes">Yes, continue</option>
        <option value="exception">No, but an exception applies (see user manual)</option>
        <option value="no">No, stop here and refer to user manual</option>
      </select>
      <div id="m-prerando-exc" class="exc-note">
        <strong>Exception:</strong> ICEMAN still applies to an effect modifier measured after randomization if (1) it is a non-modifiable characteristic such as sex or age, or (2) it is a study characteristic such as risk of bias, length of follow-up, or mean received dose. <a href="manual/preliminary.html#prelim-prerando" target="iceman-manual">See user manual →</a>
      </div>
      <div id="m-prerando-warn" class="no-warn">
        <strong>Note:</strong> ICEMAN applies to effect modifiers measured before or at randomization. If the effect modifier was measured after randomization (e.g. an intermediate outcome), the analysis of effect modification is complicated and potentially misleading, and requires different methods not covered by ICEMAN. <a href="manual/preliminary.html#prelim-prerando" target="iceman-manual">See user manual for further instructions →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Outcome and time-point</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="outcome">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="m-outcome">
    </div>
    <div class="fgroup">
      <div class="field-label-row">
        <label>Effect measure</label>
        <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="measure">?</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="m-measure">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="fgroup" style="margin-bottom:0.75rem">
    <div class="field-label-row">
      <label>Does the analysis suggest a possible effect modification (interaction or meta-regression p ≤ 0.1)?</label>
      <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip="possible">?</button>
    </div>
    <select id="m-possible">
      <option value="">Select…</option>
      <option value="yes">Yes</option>
      <option value="no">No, stop here</option>
    </select>
    <div id="m-no-warn" class="no-warn">
      <strong>Note:</strong> ICEMAN was developed to assess the credibility of a <em>suggested</em> effect modification (interaction or meta-regression p ≤ 0.1). It does not apply when there is no suggestion of effect modification. Assessing the credibility of an <em>absence</em> of effect modification requires a different approach not covered by ICEMAN. <a href="manual/concepts.html" target="iceman-manual">See user manual for scope of ICEMAN →</a>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div id="m-items">

</div>

  <div class="item-num">Overall rating</div>
  <div class="item-q">How would you rate the overall credibility? <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip-type="overall" data-item-prefix="m">?</button></div>
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0.5rem 0 0.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button class="btn-tool" onclick="applyComputedRating('m')">Generate rating from responses</button>
    <span class="scale-click-hint">Click scale to rate manually</span>
    <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip-type="generate" data-item-prefix="m">?</button>
  </div>
  <div id="m-algo-result" style="display:none"></div>
  <div class="cred-wrap" id="m-cred-wrap">
    <div class="cred-bar" id="m-cred-bar" onclick="activateScale('m', event)" style="cursor:pointer">
      <div class="cred-thumb" id="m-thumb" style="left:37.5%;display:none"></div>
    </div>
    <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="37.5" class="cred-slider" id="m-scale" oninput="onSliderDrag('m')" style="pointer-events:none">
    <div class="cred-labels"><span>Very low</span><span>Low</span><span>Moderate</span><span>High</span></div>
    <div class="scale-interp" id="m-interp" style="display:none"></div>
  </div>
  <textarea class="comment-box" id="m-overallc" placeholder="Justify your overall rating…"></textarea>
</div>

<div class="action-row">
  <button class="btn-tool primary" onclick="genDocx('m')">Download Word (.docx)</button>
  <button class="btn-tool" onclick="resetForm('m')">Reset form</button>
</div>
<div id="m-report"></div>

</div><!-- end m-items -->
</div><!-- end tab-meta -->

<div id="val-modal">
  <div id="val-modal-box">
    <h3 id="val-modal-title">Required fields missing</h3>
    <p id="val-modal-msg">Please complete all required fields before continuing.</p>
    <button onclick="document.getElementById('val-modal').classList.remove('open')">OK</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="tip-card"></div>

<script>
// Release the manual tab name so navigating here doesn't trap a manual tab.
if (window.name === 'iceman-manual') window.name = '';

// DEV FLAG — set to true to show the scoring-details box (weighted score,
// item counts, safety-rule notes) after clicking "Generate rating".
// For developer use only. Set to false before publishing.
const DEV_ALGO_BOX = false;

const RCT_PRELIM = {
  placeholders: {
    ref:     'e.g. study name, citation, protocol',
    outcome: 'e.g. mortality at 1 year',
    measure: 'e.g. relative risk',
    mod:     'e.g. age, disease severity, dose',
  },
  tips: {
    ref:      { text: 'Link this form to the trial — e.g. author-year citation, DOI, trial acronym, or registry number. You may also note the comparison of interest.', anchor: '#prelim-ref' },
    outcome:  { text: 'ICEMAN applies to one outcome at a time. Specify the outcome and, where relevant, the time-point of assessment (e.g. mortality at 1 year).', anchor: '#prelim-outcome' },
    measure:  { text: 'Specify one effect measure (e.g. relative risk, risk difference, hazard ratio). Credibility ratings can differ between relative and absolute measures — complete a separate form for each.', anchor: '#prelim-measure' },
    modifier: { text: 'State one potential effect modifier — a patient or intervention characteristic. Note: ICEMAN does not apply when the modifier is another outcome.', anchor: '#prelim-modifier' },
    prerando: { text: 'ICEMAN applies to effect modifiers measured before or at randomization (e.g. baseline variables). Effect modifiers measured after randomization (e.g. an intermediate outcome) require different methods. <strong>Exception:</strong> ICEMAN still applies if the effect modifier is a non-modifiable characteristic such as sex or age.', anchor: '#prelim-prerando' },
    possible: { text: 'ICEMAN applies when the statistical analysis shows at least some signal of possible effect modification, such as an interaction p-value of 0.1 or smaller. Do not apply ICEMAN when the p-value is larger than 0.1, or when the data suggest no effect modification.', anchor: '#prelim-possible' },
  },
};

const META_PRELIM = {
  placeholders: {
    ref:     'e.g. study name, citation, protocol',
    outcome: 'e.g. mortality at 1 year',
    measure: 'e.g. hazard ratio',
    mod:     'e.g. tumour type, mean age, risk of bias',
  },
  tips: {
    ref:      { text: 'Link this form to the review — e.g. author-year citation, DOI, review acronym, or PROSPERO ID. You may also note the comparison of interest.', anchor: '#prelim-ref' },
    outcome:  { text: 'ICEMAN applies to one outcome at a time. Specify the outcome and, where relevant, the time-point of assessment (e.g. mortality at 1 year).', anchor: '#prelim-outcome' },
    measure:  { text: 'Specify one effect measure (e.g. relative risk, risk difference, hazard ratio). Credibility ratings can differ between relative and absolute measures — complete a separate form for each.', anchor: '#prelim-measure' },
    modifier: { text: 'State one potential effect modifier — a patient, intervention, or study characteristic (e.g. risk of bias, follow-up length). Note: ICEMAN does not apply when the modifier is another outcome.', anchor: '#prelim-modifier' },
    prerando: { text: 'ICEMAN applies to effect modifiers measured before or at randomization (e.g. baseline variables). Effect modifiers measured after randomization (e.g. an intermediate outcome) require different methods. <strong>Exceptions:</strong> ICEMAN still applies if the effect modifier is (1) a non-modifiable characteristic such as sex or age, or (2) a study characteristic such as risk of bias, length of follow-up, or mean received dose.', anchor: '#prelim-prerando' },
    possible: { text: 'Apply ICEMAN only when interaction or meta-regression p ≤ 0.1. With p > 0.1, use the overall effect estimate and state that no ICEMAN assessment was performed.', anchor: '#prelim-possible' },
  },
};



const GENERAL_TIPS = {
  'study-type': {
    text: 'Select whether you assess effect modification in an individual randomized controlled trial or a meta-analysis of trials. For other study types, such as cohort studies or meta-analyses of observational studies, choose the version that fits best and lower your overall credibility rating to reflect the additional uncertainty.',
    anchor: 'manual/preliminary.html',
  },
};

(function() {
  Object.entries(RCT_PRELIM.placeholders).forEach(([key, ph]) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(`r-${key}`);
    if (el) el.placeholder = ph;
  });
  Object.entries(META_PRELIM.placeholders).forEach(([key, ph]) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(`m-${key}`);
    if (el) el.placeholder = ph;
  });
})();

const card = document.getElementById('tip-card');
let hideTimer;

function showTip(btn) {
  clearTimeout(hideTimer);
  const tipType = btn.dataset.tipType;
  let tipText, manualHref;
  if (tipType === 'item') {
    const pfx = btn.dataset.itemPrefix;
    const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.itemIdx);
    const item = (pfx === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS)[idx];
    tipText = item.hint;
    manualHref = item.manualLink.replace('.qmd', '.html');
  } else if (tipType === 'overall') {
    const pfx = btn.dataset.itemPrefix;
    const cfg = pfx === 'r' ? OVERALL_TIPS.rct : OVERALL_TIPS.meta;
    tipText = cfg.text;
    manualHref = cfg.manualHref;
  } else if (tipType === 'generate') {
    const pfx = btn.dataset.itemPrefix;
    tipText = 'The calculated score provides an orientation only. It gives equal weight to all core items which may not be appropriate. Click on the scale to adjust manually. When you change a response, the rating will adjust automatically.';
    manualHref = pfx === 'r' ? 'manual/rct.html#rct-item7' : 'manual/meta.html#meta-item10';
  } else {
    const key = btn.dataset.tip;
    const general = GENERAL_TIPS[key];
    if (general) {
      tipText = general.text;
      manualHref = general.anchor;
    } else {
      const isRct = !!btn.closest('#tab-rct');
      const tip = (isRct ? RCT_PRELIM : META_PRELIM).tips[key];
      if (!tip) return;
      tipText = tip.text;
      manualHref = 'manual/preliminary.html' + tip.anchor;
    }
  }
  const bodyHtml = tipText ? `<div style="margin:0">${tipText}</div>` : '';
  card.innerHTML = `${bodyHtml}<a class="tip-card-link" href="${manualHref}" target="iceman-manual">Open in user manual for more explanation →</a>`;
  const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  card.style.left = Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - 332) + 'px';
  card.style.top  = (r.bottom + 8) + 'px';
  card.style.display = 'block';
}

document.body.addEventListener('mouseover', e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.tip-trigger');
  if (!btn || btn.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
  showTip(btn);
});
document.body.addEventListener('mouseout', e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.tip-trigger');
  if (!btn || btn.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => { card.style.display = 'none'; }, 200);
});
card.addEventListener('mouseover', e => { if (!card.contains(e.relatedTarget)) clearTimeout(hideTimer); });
card.addEventListener('mouseout',  e => { if (!card.contains(e.relatedTarget)) hideTimer = setTimeout(() => { card.style.display = 'none'; }, 200); });

// ── Item content ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const OVERALL_TIPS = {
  rct: {
    text: 'The overall rating should be driven by the items that decrease credibility. Sensible strategy:<ul style="margin:0.5rem 0 0 1.1rem;padding:0"><li>All definitely or probably reduced → very low</li><li>Two or more definitely reduced → maximum usually low</li><li>One definitely reduced → maximum usually moderate</li><li>Two probably reduced → maximum usually moderate</li><li>No definitely or probably reduced → high very likely</li></ul>',
    manualHref: 'manual/rct.html#rct-item7',

  meta: {

Sensible strategy:<ul style="margin:0.5rem 0 0 1.1rem;padding:0"><li>All definitely or probably reduced → very low</li><li>Two or more definitely reduced → maximum usually low</li><li>One definitely reduced → maximum usually moderate</li><li>Two probably reduced → maximum usually moderate</li><li>No definitely or probably reduced → high very likely</li></ul>',

};
```
