```{=html}
function rlColor(v) {
  if (v === '1')   return ' rl-red';
  if (v === '2' || v === 'dec') return ' rl-orange';
  if (v === '3' || v === 'inc') return ' rl-yellow';
  if (v === '4')   return ' rl-green';
  return '';
}

function renderItems(items, prefix) {
  return items.map((item, i) => {
    const n    = i + 1;
    const name = `${prefix}-q${n}`;
    const cid  = `${name}c`;
    const opts = item.options.map(o =>
      `<label class="radio-row"><input type="radio" name="${name}" value="${o.value}"><span><span class="rl${rlColor(o.value)}">${o.label}</span>${o.desc ? `<br><span class="rd">${o.desc}</span>` : ''}</span></label>`
    ).join('');
    return `
<div class="iceman-item" id="${prefix}-item-${n}" style="scroll-margin-top:72px">
  <div class="item-num">Item ${item.num}</div>
  <div class="item-q">${item.q} <button class="tip-trigger" data-tip-type="item" data-item-prefix="${prefix}" data-item-idx="${i}">?</button></div>
  <div id="${name}">${opts}</div>
  <textarea class="comment-box" id="${cid}" placeholder="${item.commentPlaceholder || 'Justify your rating…'}"></textarea>
</div>`;
  }).join('\n');
}

document.getElementById('r-item-cards').innerHTML = renderItems(RCT_ITEMS, 'r');
document.getElementById('m-item-cards').innerHTML = renderItems(META_ITEMS, 'm');

// ── Meta Item 1 → Item 2 / Item 3 dependency ─────────────────────────────────
// "Completely between" (0) → Item 2 auto-NA + greyed out
// "Completely within"  (3) → Item 3 auto-NA + greyed out
function setItemAutoNA(itemNum) {
  const name = `m-q${itemNum}`;
  document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${name}"]`).forEach(inp => {
    inp.closest('.radio-row').classList.remove('selected');
    inp.checked = false;
  });
  const naInput = document.querySelector(`input[name="${name}"][value="na"]`);
  if (naInput) {
    naInput.checked = true;
    naInput.closest('.radio-row').classList.add('selected');
  }
  const itemCard = document.getElementById(name)?.closest('.iceman-item');
  if (itemCard) itemCard.classList.add('item-auto-na');
}

function clearItemAutoNA(itemNum) {
  const name = `m-q${itemNum}`;
  const itemCard = document.getElementById(name)?.closest('.iceman-item');
  if (!itemCard?.classList.contains('item-auto-na')) return;
  itemCard.classList.remove('item-auto-na');
  document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${name}"]`).forEach(inp => {
    inp.closest('.radio-row').classList.remove('selected');
    inp.checked = false;
  });
}

function applyMetaItem1Deps(val) {
  if (val === '1') {
    setItemAutoNA(2);
    clearItemAutoNA(3);
  } else if (val === '4') {
    setItemAutoNA(3);
    clearItemAutoNA(2);
  } else {
    clearItemAutoNA(2);
    clearItemAutoNA(3);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function switchTab(t, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + t).classList.add('active');
  btn.classList.add('active');
  const ph = document.getElementById('study-placeholder');
  if (ph) ph.style.display = 'none';
}

// Items are always visible; these handlers clear validation state, toggle the
// note shown for each answer, and trigger live rating.
const PRELIM_NOTES = {
  prerando: { no: 'prerando-warn', exception: 'prerando-exc' },
  possible: { no: 'no-warn' },
};
['r', 'm'].forEach(p => Object.entries(PRELIM_NOTES).forEach(([key, notes]) => {
  document.getElementById(`${p}-${key}`).addEventListener('change', e => {
    e.target.classList.remove('field-invalid');
    Object.entries(notes).forEach(([val, suffix]) => {
      const note = document.getElementById(`${p}-${suffix}`);
      if (note) note.style.display = e.target.value === val ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
    tryLiveRate(p);
  });
}));

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const row = e.target.closest('.radio-row');
  if (!row) return;
  const input = row.querySelector('input[type=radio]');
  if (!input) return;
  const name = input.name;
  document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${name}"]`).forEach(i => {
    i.closest('.radio-row').classList.remove('selected');
  });
  row.classList.add('selected');
  input.checked = true;
  row.closest('.iceman-item')?.classList.remove('item-invalid');
  if (name === 'm-q1') applyMetaItem1Deps(input.value);
  const p = name.startsWith('r-') ? 'r' : name.startsWith('m-') ? 'm' : null;
  if (p === 'r') { autoMode['r'] = true; updateLiveSummary('r'); tryLiveRate('r'); }
  else if (p === 'm') { autoMode['m'] = true; updateLiveSummary('m'); tryLiveRate('m'); }
});

document.addEventListener('input', e => {
  if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' && e.target.type === 'text') {
    e.target.classList.remove('field-invalid');
  }
  if (e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
    e.target.classList.remove('comment-warn');
    const id = e.target.id || '';
    if (id.startsWith('r-') && id !== 'r-overallc') updateLiveSummary('r');
    if (id.startsWith('m-') && id !== 'm-overallc') updateLiveSummary('m');
  }
});

const interpLabels = [
  'minimal to no support for effect modification — use overall effect for each subgroup',
  'some but insufficient support for effect modification — use overall effect for each subgroup but note remaining uncertainty',
  'likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup but note remaining uncertainty',
  'very likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup'
];
const ratingLabels = ['Very low','Low','Moderate','High'];
const ratingColors = ['#c0392b','#d35400','#9a7d0a','#1a7a4a'];

function updateStickyBar(val) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('sticky-bar');
  const thumb = document.getElementById('sb-thumb');
  if (!bar) return;
  bar.classList.add('visible');
  thumb.style.left = val + '%';
  const idx = val <= 25 ? 0 : val <= 50 ? 1 : val <= 75 ? 2 : 3;
  const label = ratingLabels[idx];
  const color = ratingColors[idx];
  const leftEl  = document.getElementById('sb-left');
  const rightEl = document.getElementById('sb-right');
  if (idx <= 1) {
    leftEl.textContent  = label; leftEl.style.color  = color;
    rightEl.textContent = '';    rightEl.style.color = '';
  } else {
    leftEl.textContent  = '';    leftEl.style.color  = '';
    rightEl.textContent = label; rightEl.style.color = color;
  }
}

function activePrefix() {
  return document.getElementById('tab-rct')?.classList.contains('active') ? 'r' : 'm';
}

function sbClick(e) {
  const barEl = document.querySelector('#sb-bar-wrap .sb-bar');
  const rect  = barEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pct   = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * 100));
  const p     = activePrefix();
  showScale(p);
  autoMode[p] = false;
  document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value = pct;
  moveThumb(p);
}

function moveThumb(p) {
  const val = +document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value;
  document.getElementById(p + '-thumb').style.left = val + '%';
  const idx = val <= 25 ? 0 : val <= 50 ? 1 : val <= 75 ? 2 : 3;
  document.getElementById(p + '-interp').innerHTML = `<strong>${ratingLabels[idx]}:</strong> <span style="font-weight:400">${interpLabels[idx]}</span>`;
  updateStickyBar(val);
}

// Track whether each form is in auto-rating mode.
// Auto mode is on by default; manual slider drag turns it off;
// clicking "Generate rating from responses" turns it back on.
const autoMode = { r: true, m: true };
const scaleActive = { r: false, m: false };

function onSliderDrag(p) {
  moveThumb(p);
  autoMode[p] = false;
}

function showScale(p) {
  scaleActive[p] = true;
  const thumb = document.getElementById(p + '-thumb');
  if (thumb) thumb.style.display = 'block';
  const slider = document.getElementById(p + '-scale');
  if (slider) slider.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  const interp = document.getElementById(p + '-interp');
  if (interp) interp.style.display = 'block';
  const bar = document.getElementById(p + '-cred-bar');
  if (bar) bar.style.cursor = 'default';
}

function showModal(title, msg) {
  document.getElementById('val-modal-title').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('val-modal-msg').textContent = msg;
  document.getElementById('val-modal').classList.add('open');
}

function showInlineWarn(p, msg) {
  const warnId = `${p}-inline-warn`;
  let warn = document.getElementById(warnId);
  if (!warn) {
    warn = document.createElement('div');
    warn.id = warnId;
    warn.className = 'inline-warn';
    const credWrap = document.getElementById(`${p}-cred-wrap`);
    credWrap?.parentNode.insertBefore(warn, credWrap);
  }
  warn.innerHTML = `<span>${msg}</span><button onclick="this.parentElement.style.display='none'">✕</button>`;
  warn.style.display = 'flex';
  setTimeout(() => { if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none'; }, 8000);
}

// Highlight missing prelim fields + core items. Returns { missingPrelim, missingItems }.
function highlightMissing(p) {
  let missingPrelim = false;
  let missingItems = false;
  ['outcome', 'measure', 'mod'].forEach(key => {
    const el = document.getElementById(`${p}-${key}`);
    if (!el) return;
    const empty = el.value.trim() === '';
    el.classList.toggle('field-invalid', empty);
    if (empty) missingPrelim = true;
  });
  ['prerando', 'possible'].forEach(key => {
    const sel = document.getElementById(`${p}-${key}`);
    if (sel && sel.value === '') {
      sel.classList.add('field-invalid');
      missingPrelim = true;
    }
  });
  const cfg = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  cfg.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (item.commentPlaceholder) return;
    const radioGroup = document.getElementById(`${p}-q${i + 1}`);
    const itemDiv = radioGroup?.closest('.iceman-item');
    if (!itemDiv) return;
    const missing = !getVal(`${p}-q${i + 1}`);
    itemDiv.classList.toggle('item-invalid', missing);
    if (missing) missingItems = true;
  });
  return { missingPrelim, missingItems };
}

// Highlight comment boxes that are empty and return list of their IDs.
// Skips items where NA is selected (manual or auto-set by dependency logic).
function highlightMissingJustifications(p) {
  const cfg = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const emptyIds = [];
  cfg.forEach((item, i) => {
    const name     = `${p}-q${i + 1}`;
    const cid      = `${name}c`;
    const ta       = document.getElementById(cid);
    if (!ta) return;
    // Skip if NA is selected (covers both manual NA and auto-NA from item dependency)
    if (getVal(name) === 'na') { ta.classList.remove('comment-warn'); return; }
    // Skip if item card is greyed out by auto-NA dependency (belt-and-suspenders)
    const itemCard = document.getElementById(name)?.closest('.iceman-item');
    if (itemCard?.classList.contains('item-auto-na')) { ta.classList.remove('comment-warn'); return; }
    const empty = ta.value.trim() === '';
    ta.classList.toggle('comment-warn', empty);
    if (empty) emptyIds.push(cid);
  });
  const overallC = document.getElementById(`${p}-overallc`);
  if (overallC && overallC.value.trim() === '') {
    overallC.classList.add('comment-warn');
    emptyIds.push(`${p}-overallc`);
  }
  return emptyIds;
}

function activateScale(p, e) {
  // Warn about missing items only (not prelim), but still allow manual rating
  const { missingItems } = highlightMissing(p);
  if (missingItems) {
    showInlineWarn(p, 'Some assessment items are not yet answered — please complete all items before finalising your rating.');
  }

  if (scaleActive[p]) return;
  if (e) {
    const bar = document.getElementById(p + '-cred-bar');
    const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * 100));
    document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value = pct;
    moveThumb(p);
  }
  showScale(p);
  autoMode[p] = false;
}

function renderRatingResult(p, result) {
  const resultDiv = document.getElementById(p + '-algo-result');

  const countsLine = `(--)=${result.D} (-)=${result.Pm} (+)=${result.Pp} (++)=${result.PP} · N=${result.N}`;

  let scoreLine;
  if (result.addl_adj !== 0) {
    const adjStr = result.addl_adj > 0 ? `+${result.addl_adj}` : `${result.addl_adj}`;
    scoreLine = `Weighted score: ${result.weighted_score.toFixed(1)} ${adjStr} (additional) = ${result.adjusted_score.toFixed(1)}`;
  } else {
    scoreLine = `Weighted score: ${result.weighted_score.toFixed(1)}`;
  }

  const ruleNotesList = [];
  if (result.all_reducing_applied) {
    ruleNotesList.push('All items reduce or are unclear → Very low');
  } else if (result.pm4_applied) {
    ruleNotesList.push('count(-) ≥ 4 → Very low');
  } else {
    if (result.pm3_applied)    ruleNotesList.push('count(-) = 3 → capped to Low');
    if (result.no_high_applied) ruleNotesList.push('count(—) ≥ 1 → capped to Moderate');
  }
  const ruleNotes = ruleNotesList.map(r => `<div class="algo-shift">Safety rule: ${r}</div>`).join('');

  const prelimNote = result.final_rating !== result.preliminary_rating
    ? ` (preliminary: ${result.preliminary_rating})`
    : '';

  resultDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="algo-result">
    <strong>${result.final_rating}${prelimNote}:</strong> ${result.rating_meaning}.
    <div class="algo-counts">${scoreLine} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${countsLine}</div>
    ${ruleNotes}
  </div>`;
  resultDiv.style.display = DEV_ALGO_BOX ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value = result.final_slider_score;
  moveThumb(p);
}

// Called on every response change. If auto mode is on and all core items
// are answered, updates the scale live (mirrors the Generate button logic).
function tryLiveRate(p) {
  if (!autoMode[p]) return;
  if (!scaleActive[p]) return;
  const result = computeOverallRating(p, { ignorePossible: true });
  if (result.blocked) return;
  renderRatingResult(p, result);
}

function getVal(name) {
  const el = document.querySelector(`input[name="${name}"]:checked`);
  return el ? el.value : null;
}

// ── ICEMAN Step 2: Response coding ───────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Maps a raw response value to a credibility-impact code and item_value used
// in the score formula.
//
// item_value represents position on the 0–100 credibility scale:
//   (--) = 0   (37.5 points below neutral default of 37.5)
//   (-)  = 25  (12.5 points below neutral default)
//   (+)  = 75  (37.5 points above neutral default)
//   (++) = 100 (62.5 points above neutral default)
//
// "Unclear" always codes as (-) — value '1' captures every option whose
// label contains "or unclear" (e.g. "Probably no or unclear").
// N/A items are excluded from the denominator; they neither help nor hurt.
// Additional-considerations items ('dec'/'inc') are excluded from core counts;
// they shift the score by ±25 after the core score is computed.
// A missing applicable core item blocks the algorithm.
//
// Value → label examples:
//   '0'  → "Definitely no", "Inconsistent with prior evidence", …   → (--)
//   '1'  → "Probably no or unclear", "Little or no support", …      → (-)
//   '2'  → "Probably yes", "Some support", …                        → (+)
//   '3'  → "Definitely yes", "Strong support", …                    → (++)
//   'na' → "Not applicable" — excluded from denominator
//   'dec'→ Additional: probably decreases credibility — not a core item
//   'inc'→ Additional: probably increases credibility — not a core item
//   null / '' → missing — blocks the algorithm

function codeResponse(val) {
  if (val == null || val === '') {
    return { impact_code: null, item_value: null, include_in_core_counts: false, is_missing: true };
  }
  switch (val) {
    case '1':   return { impact_code: '--', item_value: 0,    include_in_core_counts: true,  is_missing: false };
    case '2':   return { impact_code: '-',  item_value: 25,   include_in_core_counts: true,  is_missing: false };
    case '3':   return { impact_code: '+',  item_value: 75,   include_in_core_counts: true,  is_missing: false };
    case '4':   return { impact_code: '++', item_value: 100,  include_in_core_counts: true,  is_missing: false };
    case 'na':  return { impact_code: 'NA', item_value: null, include_in_core_counts: false, is_missing: false };
    case 'dec': return { impact_code: '-',  item_value: null, include_in_core_counts: false, is_missing: false };
    case 'inc': return { impact_code: '+',  item_value: null, include_in_core_counts: false, is_missing: false };
    default:    return { impact_code: null, item_value: null, include_in_core_counts: false, is_missing: true  };
  }
}

// Collect coded responses for all core items of a form prefix ('r' or 'm').
// Core items = all items except "additional considerations" (flagged by commentPlaceholder).
function collectCoreResponses(p) {
  const cfg = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  return cfg
    .map((item, i) => ({ item, i, val: getVal(`${p}-q${i + 1}`) }))
    .filter(r => !r.item.commentPlaceholder)
    .map(r => ({ ...r, coded: codeResponse(r.val) }));
}

// Compute item counts from an array returned by collectCoreResponses().
//   D  = count(--)  item_value 0   — definitely reduces credibility
//   Pm = count(-)   item_value 25  — probably reduces or unclear
//   Pp = count(+)   item_value 75  — probably increases credibility
//   PP = count(++)  item_value 100 — definitely increases credibility
//   N  = D + Pm + Pp + PP (N/A items excluded from denominator)
// Returns blocked:true if any applicable core item is missing.
function computeItemCounts(coreResponses) {
  if (coreResponses.some(r => r.coded.is_missing)) {
    return { D: null, Pm: null, Pp: null, PP: null, N: null, blocked: true };
  }
  const rated = coreResponses.filter(r => r.coded.include_in_core_counts);
  return {
    D:  rated.filter(r => r.coded.item_value === 0).length,
    Pm: rated.filter(r => r.coded.item_value === 25).length,
    Pp: rated.filter(r => r.coded.item_value === 75).length,
    PP: rated.filter(r => r.coded.item_value === 100).length,
    N:  rated.length,
    blocked: false,
  };
}

// Step 2 self-test — runs once at page load; silent on pass, warns on fail.
(() => {
  const cases = [
    { val: '1',  label: 'Definitely no',           code: '--', iv: 0,    core: true,  miss: false },
    { val: '2',  label: 'Probably no or unclear',  code: '-',  iv: 25,   core: true,  miss: false },
    { val: '3',  label: 'Probably yes',            code: '+',  iv: 75,   core: true,  miss: false },
    { val: '4',  label: 'Definitely yes',          code: '++', iv: 100,  core: true,  miss: false },
    { val: 'na', label: 'Not applicable',          code: 'NA', iv: null, core: false, miss: false },
    { val: null, label: 'Missing (null)',           code: null, iv: null, core: false, miss: true  },
    { val: '',   label: 'Missing (empty string)',   code: null, iv: null, core: false, miss: true  },
  ];
  let pass = true;
  cases.forEach(c => {
    const r = codeResponse(c.val);
    if (r.impact_code !== c.code || r.item_value !== c.iv ||
        r.include_in_core_counts !== c.core || r.is_missing !== c.miss) {
      console.warn('[ICEMAN Step 2 FAILED]', c.label, 'got:', r);
      pass = false;
    }
  });
  if (pass) console.log('[ICEMAN Step 2] Response-coding self-test passed ✓');
})();

// ── ICEMAN weighted-score rating algorithm ───────────────────────────────────
//
// WEIGHTED SCORE
// Each applicable core item is assigned a value and a weight that reflect its
// credibility impact. Definite concerns receive higher weight so they pull the
// average down more strongly than probable concerns:
//
//   Response  Value  Weight
//   (--)        0     3      — definitely reduces credibility (strong weight)
//   (-)        30     1.5    — probably reduces or unclear   (moderate weight)
//   (+)        60     1      — probably increases credibility
//   (++)       90     1      — definitely increases credibility
//
// weighted_score = Σ(value_i × weight_i) / Σ(weight_i)
//                 summed over all applicable (non-N/A) core items
//
// "Unclear" always counts as (-): value '1' captures all options labelled
// "or unclear". N/A items are excluded from the numerator and denominator.
//
// The weighted score is a heuristic display aid, not a validated measurement.
//
// PRELIMINARY RATING (strict upper-bound boundaries)
//   weighted_score > 75  → High      (75 itself = Moderate)
//   weighted_score > 50  → Moderate  (50 itself = Low)
//   weighted_score > 25  → Low       (25 itself = Very low)
//   weighted_score <= 25 → Very low
//
// SAFETY RULES (preserve ICEMAN logic after the weighted score)
//   Rule 1: if all applicable items are (-) or (--), final_rating = Very low.
//            Even if the preliminary rating is Low, unanimous reduction of
//            credibility warrants the lowest rating.
//   Rule 2: if count(--) >= 1 and preliminary_rating is High, cap to Moderate.
//            A single definite credibility concern is incompatible with High.
//
// FINAL SLIDER SCORE
// Use weighted_score as the slider value, but cap it to the upper bound of the
// final rating band so the slider never visually contradicts the rating:
//   Very low → min(weighted_score, 25)
//   Low      → min(weighted_score, 50)
//   Moderate → min(weighted_score, 75)
//   High     → weighted_score  (no cap)
//
// ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS
// Not included in the weighted score (not a core item). Displayed separately.
// Could later shift the slider slightly, but should not be treated as a core item.

const ICEMAN_LEVELS = ['Very low', 'Low', 'Moderate', 'High'];

const ICEMAN_MEANINGS = {
  'Very low': 'Minimal to no support for effect modification',
  'Low':      'Some but insufficient support for effect modification',
  'Moderate': 'Likely effect modification, but uncertainty remains',
  'High':     'Very likely effect modification',
};

// Returns the weighted average score (0–90 range before slider mapping).
// Returns 0 when the denominator is zero (all items N/A — degenerate edge case).
function weightedScore(D, Pm, Pp, PP) {
  const num = 0 * 3 * D + 30 * 1.5 * Pm + 60 * 1 * Pp + 90 * 1 * PP;
  const den = 3 * D + 1.5 * Pm + 1 * Pp + 1 * PP;
  return den === 0 ? 0 : num / den;
}

function ratingFromScore(score) {
  if (score > 75) return 'High';
  if (score > 50) return 'Moderate';
  if (score > 25) return 'Low';
  return 'Very low';
}

const RATING_ORDER = ['Very low', 'Low', 'Moderate', 'High'];
function lowerRating(a, b) {
  return RATING_ORDER.indexOf(a) <= RATING_ORDER.indexOf(b) ? a : b;
}

// Caps the slider value to the upper boundary of the final rating band.
function capSliderToRating(score, rating) {
  if (rating === 'Very low') return score > 25 ? 19 : score;
  if (rating === 'Low')      return score > 50 ? 44 : score;
  if (rating === 'Moderate') return score > 75 ? 69 : score;
  return score;
}

// ── Main entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Reads the current DOM state for prefix 'r' or 'm' and returns a result object.
// Never throws.

function computeOverallRating(p, opts = {}) {
  // Eligibility 1 — interaction p-value check (skipped when ignorePossible=true)
  if (!opts.ignorePossible) {
    const possible = document.getElementById(p + '-possible').value;
    if (possible !== 'yes') {
      return {
        blocked: true,
        reason: 'ICEMAN not applied: interaction p-value > 0.1.',
        D: null, Pm: null, Pp: null, PP: null, N: null,
      };
    }
  }

  // Eligibility 2 — collect and code core item responses
  const coreResponses = collectCoreResponses(p);
  const counts = computeItemCounts(coreResponses);
  if (counts.blocked) {
    return {
      blocked: true,
      reason: 'Overall rating cannot be generated because one or more core ICEMAN items are missing.',
      D: null, Pm: null, Pp: null, PP: null, N: null,
    };
  }

  const { D, Pm, Pp, PP, N } = counts;

  // Compute weighted score from core items
  const ws = weightedScore(D, Pm, Pp, PP);

  // Read additional considerations
  const cfg      = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const addlIdx  = cfg.findIndex(item => item.commentPlaceholder);
  const addl_val = addlIdx >= 0 ? getVal(`${p}-q${addlIdx + 1}`) : null;

  // Apply ±5 adjustment from additional considerations, clamp to [0, 100]
  const addl_adj       = addl_val === 'dec' ? -5 : addl_val === 'inc' ? 5 : 0;
  const adjusted_score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ws + addl_adj));

  // Convert adjusted score to preliminary rating
  const preliminary_rating = ratingFromScore(adjusted_score);

  // Safety rules (evaluated in priority order)
  // Rule 1: all applicable items are (-) or (—) → Very low
  const all_reducing_applied = N > 0 && (D + Pm) === N;
  // Rule 2: count(-) >= 4 → Very low
  const pm4_applied          = !all_reducing_applied && Pm >= 4;
  // Rule 3: count(-) == 3 → cap at Low  (can stack with rule 4)
  const pm3_applied          = !all_reducing_applied && !pm4_applied && Pm === 3;
  // Rule 4: count(—) >= 1 → cap at Moderate  (can stack with rule 3)
  const no_high_applied      = !all_reducing_applied && !pm4_applied && D >= 1;

  let final_rating;
  if (all_reducing_applied || pm4_applied) {
    final_rating = 'Very low';
  } else {
    final_rating = preliminary_rating;
    if (pm3_applied)    final_rating = lowerRating(final_rating, 'Low');
    if (no_high_applied) final_rating = lowerRating(final_rating, 'Moderate');
  }

  // Slider: cap adjusted_score to the final rating's band, then clamp to [0, 100]
  const final_slider_score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, capSliderToRating(adjusted_score, final_rating)));

  return {
    blocked:             false,
    reason:              null,
    weighted_score:      ws,
    adjusted_score,
    addl_adj,
    preliminary_rating,
    all_reducing_applied,
    pm4_applied,
    pm3_applied,
    no_high_applied,
    final_rating,
    rating_meaning:      ICEMAN_MEANINGS[final_rating],
    final_slider_score,
    D, Pm, Pp, PP, N,
    addl_val,
  };
}

// ── Self-test — pure logic, no DOM ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Cases 13–15 require DOM state; verify manually:
//   13 & 14. possible != 'yes' → "ICEMAN not applied: interaction p-value > 0.1."
//   15.      Any applicable core item unanswered → "one or more core ICEMAN items are missing"
//
// Note: the spec's example values for cases 6, 7, 9 differ slightly from the
// formula (285/5.5 ≈ 51.82 not 52.5; 270/6 = 45 not 47.1; 360/7 ≈ 51.43 not 55).
// Actual computed values are used here.
(() => {
  // [label, D, Pm, Pp, PP, addl, expWS, expAdj, expPrelim, expFinal, expAllReduc, expPm4, expPm3, expNoHigh, expSlider]
  const cases = [
    ['1.  All (+) → Moderate',               0, 0, 5, 0,   null,  60,        60,          'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 60        ],
    ['2.  All (++) → High',                  0, 0, 0, 5,   null,  90,        90,          'High',     'High',     false, false, false, false, 90        ],
    ['3.  Four (+), one (++)',               0, 0, 4, 1,   null,  66,        66,          'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 66        ],
    ['4.  Three (+), two (++)',              0, 0, 3, 2,   null,  72,        72,          'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 72        ],
    ['5.  Two (+), three (++)',              0, 0, 2, 3,   null,  78,        78,          'High',     'High',     false, false, false, false, 78        ],
    ['6.  Four (+), one (-)',                0, 1, 4, 0,   null,  285/5.5,   285/5.5,     'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 285/5.5   ],
    ['7.  Three (+), two (-)',               0, 2, 3, 0,   null,  45,        45,          'Low',      'Low',      false, false, false, false, 45        ],
    ['8.  Four (+), one (—)',                1, 0, 4, 0,   null,  240/7,     240/7,       'Low',      'Low',      false, false, false, true,  240/7     ],
    ['9.  Four (++), one (—)',               1, 0, 0, 4,   null,  360/7,     360/7,       'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, true,  360/7     ],
    ['10. D=1, PP=20: High → Mod',          1, 0, 0, 20,  null,  1800/23,   1800/23,     'High',     'Moderate', false, false, false, true,  69        ],
    ['11. All (-) → all-reducing, Very low', 0, 5, 0, 0,   null,  30,        30,          'Low',      'Very low', true,  false, false, false, 19        ],
    ['12. All (—) → all-reducing, Very low', 5, 0, 0, 0,   null,  0,         0,           'Very low', 'Very low', true,  false, false, false, 0         ],
    // Additional considerations ±5 adjustment
    ['13. Addl dec: Mod stays Mod',          0, 0, 5, 0,   'dec', 60,        55,          'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 55        ],
    ['14. Addl dec: Mod → Low',              0, 1, 4, 0,   'dec', 285/5.5,   285/5.5-5,   'Low',      'Low',      false, false, false, false, 285/5.5-5 ],
    ['15. Addl inc: Low → Mod',              0, 1, 3, 0,   'inc', 50,        55,          'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, false, 55        ],
    // count(-) accumulation rules
    ['16. Pm=4, PP=1, dec: pm4 → Very low', 0, 4, 0, 1,   'dec', 270/7,     270/7-5,     'Low',      'Very low', false, true,  false, false, 19        ],
    ['17. Pm=3, PP=2: pm3 caps Low',        0, 3, 0, 2,   null,  315/6.5,   315/6.5,     'Low',      'Low',      false, false, true,  false, 315/6.5   ],
    ['18. Pm=3, PP=3: pm3 caps Mod → Low',  0, 3, 0, 3,   null,  54,        54,          'Moderate', 'Low',      false, false, true,  false, 44        ],
    ['19. D=1, PP=4: no_high caps Mod',     1, 0, 0, 4,   null,  360/7,     360/7,       'Moderate', 'Moderate', false, false, false, true,  360/7     ],
    ['20. Mixed D+Pm all-reducing',         2, 3, 0, 0,   null,  135/10.5,  135/10.5,    'Very low', 'Very low', true,  false, false, false, 135/10.5  ],
  ];

  let pass = true;
  cases.forEach(([label, D, Pm, Pp, PP, addl, expWS, expAdj, expPrelim, expFinal, expAllReduc, expPm4, expPm3, expNoHigh, expSlider]) => {
    const ws          = weightedScore(D, Pm, Pp, PP);
    const addl_adj    = addl === 'dec' ? -5 : addl === 'inc' ? 5 : 0;
    const adj         = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ws + addl_adj));
    const prelim      = ratingFromScore(adj);
    const N           = D + Pm + Pp + PP;
    const all_reduc   = N > 0 && (D + Pm) === N;
    const pm4         = !all_reduc && Pm >= 4;
    const pm3         = !all_reduc && !pm4 && Pm === 3;
    const no_high     = !all_reduc && !pm4 && D >= 1;
    let final         = (all_reduc || pm4) ? 'Very low' : prelim;
    if (!all_reduc && !pm4) {
      if (pm3)    final = lowerRating(final, 'Low');
      if (no_high) final = lowerRating(final, 'Moderate');
    }
    const slider      = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, capSliderToRating(adj, final)));

    const ok = Math.abs(ws - expWS) < 0.001 &&
               Math.abs(adj - expAdj) < 0.001 &&
               prelim === expPrelim && final === expFinal &&
               all_reduc === expAllReduc && pm4 === expPm4 &&
               pm3 === expPm3 && no_high === expNoHigh &&
               Math.abs(slider - expSlider) < 0.001;
    if (!ok) {
      console.warn('[ICEMAN weighted FAILED]', label,
        { ws, adj, prelim, final, all_reduc, pm4, pm3, no_high, slider },
        'expected:', { expWS, expAdj, expPrelim, expFinal, expAllReduc, expPm4, expPm3, expNoHigh, expSlider });
      pass = false;
    }
  });
  if (pass) console.log('[ICEMAN weighted] Self-test passed ✓');
})();
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function badge(v) {
  if (v === null) return ['Not answered', 'b-na'];
  if (v === 'na' || v === 'none') return ['N/A', 'b-na'];
  if (v === 'inc') return ['Probably increases credibility', 'b-2'];
  if (v === 'dec') return ['Probably decreases credibility', 'b-1'];
  const n = parseInt(v);
  if (n === 1) return ['Definitely no / decreased credibility', 'b-0'];
  if (n === 2) return ['Probably no or unclear / decreased credibility', 'b-1'];
  if (n === 3) return ['Probably yes / increased credibility', 'b-2'];
  if (n === 4) return ['Definitely yes / increased credibility', 'b-3'];
  return [v, 'b-na'];
}
function verdictFromScale(val) {
  if (val > 75)  return { label: 'High credibility',     sub: 'Very likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup',                                 display: 'High: very likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup',                                             color: '#0F6E56' };
  if (val > 50)  return { label: 'Moderate credibility', sub: 'Likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup but note remaining uncertainty',       display: 'Moderate: likely effect modification — use separate effects for each subgroup but note remaining uncertainty',                   color: '#3B6D11' };
  if (val > 25)  return { label: 'Low credibility',      sub: 'Some but insufficient support for effect modification — use overall effect but note remaining uncertainty', display: 'Low: some but insufficient support for effect modification — use overall effect but note remaining uncertainty',                color: '#854F0B' };
  return          { label: 'Very low credibility',       sub: 'Minimal to no support for effect modification — use overall effect for each subgroup',                     display: 'Very low: minimal to no support for effect modification — use overall effect for each subgroup',                              color: '#A32D2D' };
}
function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;',
    "'": '&#39;'
  }[ch]));
}

function buildRows(items) {
  return items.map(item => {
    const [txt, cls] = badge(item.val);
    const comment = item.comment ? `<div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#666;padding:3px 0 6px;">${escapeHtml(item.comment)}</div>` : '';
    return `<div class="result-row"><span>${item.label}</span><span class="${cls}">${txt}</span></div>${comment}`;
  }).join('');
}

function genReport(p) {
  const isRct = p === 'r';
  const scaleVal = +document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value;
  const verdict = verdictFromScale(scaleVal);
  const ref = document.getElementById(p + '-ref')?.value || '';
  const outcome = document.getElementById(p + '-outcome').value;
  const mod = document.getElementById(p + '-mod').value;
  const overallComment = document.getElementById(p + '-overallc').value;

  const cfg = isRct ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const items = cfg.map((item, i) => ({
    label:   item.reportLabel,
    val:     getVal(`${p}-q${i + 1}`),
    comment: document.getElementById(`${p}-q${i + 1}c`).value,
  }));

  const meta = [ref, outcome ? 'Outcome: ' + outcome : '', mod ? 'Effect modifier: ' + mod : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
  const safeMeta = escapeHtml(meta);
  const safeOverallComment = escapeHtml(overallComment);
  const html = `
  <div class="result-section" id="${p}-report-content">
    <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:0.25rem">ICEMAN Assessment Report</div>
    <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#888;margin-bottom:1rem;">${isRct ? 'Randomized controlled trial' : 'Meta-analysis / Systematic review'} · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}</div>
    ${safeMeta ? `<div style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#555;margin-bottom:1rem;padding:6px 10px;background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:6px;">${safeMeta}</div>` : ''}
    ${buildRows(items)}
    <div class="verdict-box">
      <div class="verdict-label" style="color:${verdict.color}">${verdict.label}</div>
      <div class="verdict-sub">${verdict.display}</div>
      ${safeOverallComment ? `<div style="font-size:0.84rem;margin-top:0.75rem;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid #dee2e6;padding-top:0.75rem;"><strong>Comment:</strong> ${safeOverallComment}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#aaa;margin-top:1rem;">Generated with ICEMAN web tool · Version 1.1 · Schandelmaier et al. CMAJ 2020;192:E901–E906</div>
  </div>`;
  document.getElementById(p + '-report').innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById(p + '-report').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}


function updateLiveSummary(p) {
  const isRct = p === 'r';
  const cfg  = isRct ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const defs = cfg.map((item, i) => ({
    name:   `${p}-q${i + 1}`,
    itemId: `${p}-item-${i + 1}`,
    label:  item.tableLabel,
    cid:    `${p}-q${i + 1}c`,
  }));
  const rows = defs.map(d => {
    const val = getVal(d.name);
    const [txt, cls] = badge(val);
    const comment = document.getElementById(d.cid).value.trim();
    const commentHtml = comment ? `<div class="s-comment">${comment}</div>` : '';
    const badgeHtml = val === null
      ? `<a class="${cls}" href="#${d.itemId}" style="text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer">↑ answer</a>`
      : `<span class="${cls}">${txt}</span>`;
    return `<div class="summary-row"><div><div class="s-label">${d.label}</div>${commentHtml}</div>${badgeHtml}</div>`;
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById(p + '-live-summary').innerHTML =
    `<div class="live-summary-title">Summary of responses</div>${rows}`;
}

function resetForm(p) {
  document.querySelectorAll(`input[name^="${p}-"]`).forEach(i => {
    i.checked = false;
    i.closest && i.closest('.radio-row') && i.closest('.radio-row').classList.remove('selected');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(`[id^="${p}-"]`).forEach(el => {
    if (el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') el.value = '';
    if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' && el.type === 'text') el.value = '';
    if (el.tagName === 'SELECT') el.value = '';
  });
  autoMode[p] = true;
  document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value = 37.5;
  const algoDiv = document.getElementById(p + '-algo-result');
  if (algoDiv) { algoDiv.style.display = 'none'; algoDiv.innerHTML = ''; }
  scaleActive[p] = false;
  const credThumb = document.getElementById(p + '-thumb');
  if (credThumb) { credThumb.style.display = 'none'; credThumb.style.left = '37.5%'; }
  const credSlider = document.getElementById(p + '-scale');
  if (credSlider) credSlider.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  const credInterp = document.getElementById(p + '-interp');
  if (credInterp) credInterp.style.display = 'none';
  const credBar = document.getElementById(p + '-cred-bar');
  if (credBar) credBar.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  if (!scaleActive['r'] && !scaleActive['m']) {
    const sb = document.getElementById('sticky-bar');
    if (sb) sb.classList.remove('visible');
  }
  document.getElementById(p + '-report').innerHTML = '';
  // clear all validation highlights
  const tab = `#tab-${p === 'r' ? 'rct' : 'meta'}`;
  document.querySelectorAll(`${tab} .field-invalid`).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('field-invalid'));
  document.querySelectorAll(`${tab} .item-invalid`).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('item-invalid'));
  document.querySelectorAll(`${tab} .comment-warn`).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('comment-warn'));
  const inlineWarn = document.getElementById(`${p}-inline-warn`);
  if (inlineWarn) inlineWarn.style.display = 'none';
  Object.values(PRELIM_NOTES).flatMap(Object.values).forEach(suffix => {
    const note = document.getElementById(`${p}-${suffix}`);
    if (note) note.style.display = 'none';
  });
  if (p === 'm') {
    [2, 3].forEach(n => {
      const card = document.getElementById(`m-q${n}`)?.closest('.iceman-item');
      if (card) card.classList.remove('item-auto-na');
    });
  }
  document.getElementById(p + '-live-summary').innerHTML =
    '<div class="live-summary-title">Summary of responses</div>' +
    '<div class="s-label" style="color:#888;font-size:0.84rem;">— Fill in the items above to see a summary —</div>';
}

function stripHtml(s) { return s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim(); }

function getValLabel(name, item) {
  const val = getVal(name);
  if (!val) return '—';
  const opt = item.options.find(o => o.value === val);
  return opt ? opt.label : val;
}

// ── Word download ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// The download fills in the original ICEMAN form (files/*.docx) in place, so its
// wording and layout match the published instrument, and adds the summary table
// for reporting on a new page. A short contents block on page 1 names both parts.

// Pre-load the zip library so it's ready by the time the user clicks
const _zipLib = import('https://esm.sh/jszip@3.10.1').then(m => m.default);

const W_NS   = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main';
const R_NS   = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships';
const XML_NS = 'http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace';
const FORM_FILES    = { r: 'files/iceman-rct-form.docx', m: 'files/iceman-meta-analysis-form.docx' };
const REPORTING_URL = 'https://www.iceman.help/manual/index.html#reporting';
const ANSWER_COLOR  = 'FF0000';   // entered text, in the red the form uses for its own marks

// Summary table codes: (--) and (-) reduce credibility, (+) and (++) increase it
const RESPONSE_CODES = { '1': '(--)', '2': '(-)', dec: '(-)', '3': '(+)', inc: '(+)', '4': '(++)' };
const CODE_LEGEND    = '(--) definitely reduces credibility; (-) probably reduces credibility or unclear; ' +
                       '(+) probably increases credibility; (++) definitely increases credibility. ' +
                       'Not applicable items receive no code.';
const FOOTER_CREDIT  = 'Generated with ICEMAN web tool · Version 1.1 · Schandelmaier et al. CMAJ 2020;192:E901–E906 · www.iceman.help';

// Child order Word requires inside run and paragraph properties
const RPR_ORDER = ['rStyle', 'rFonts', 'b', 'bCs', 'i', 'iCs', 'caps', 'smallCaps', 'strike', 'dstrike',
  'outline', 'shadow', 'emboss', 'imprint', 'noProof', 'snapToGrid', 'vanish', 'webHidden', 'color',
  'spacing', 'w', 'kern', 'position', 'sz', 'szCs', 'highlight', 'u', 'effect', 'bdr', 'shd', 'fitText',
  'vertAlign', 'rtl', 'cs', 'em', 'lang', 'eastAsianLayout', 'specVanish', 'oMath'];
const PPR_ORDER = ['pStyle', 'keepNext', 'keepLines', 'pageBreakBefore', 'framePr', 'widowControl', 'numPr',
  'suppressLineNumbers', 'pBdr', 'shd', 'tabs', 'suppressAutoHyphens', 'kinsoku', 'wordWrap',
  'overflowPunct', 'topLinePunct', 'autoSpaceDE', 'autoSpaceDN', 'bidi', 'adjustRightInd', 'snapToGrid',
  'spacing', 'ind', 'contextualSpacing', 'mirrorIndents', 'suppressOverlap', 'jc', 'textDirection',
  'textAlignment', 'textboxTightWrap', 'outlineLvl', 'divId', 'cnfStyle', 'rPr', 'sectPr', 'pPrChange'];

const wEls  = (root, name) => [...root.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, name)];
const wKids = (el, name) => [...el.childNodes].filter(n => n.namespaceURI === W_NS && (!name || n.localName === name));
const wKid  = (el, name) => (el && wKids(el, name)[0]) || null;
const wText = el => wEls(el, 't').map(t => t.textContent).join('');
const wAttr = (el, name) => el?.getAttributeNS(W_NS, name) ?? null;

function wUp(el, name) {
  while (el && !(el.namespaceURI === W_NS && el.localName === name)) el = el.parentNode;
  return el;
}

// Escape text for XML and drop characters XML does not allow
function xmlEsc(s) {
  return String(s ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F￾￿]/g, '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function wRPr(o = {}) {
  const props = (o.bold ? '<w:b/>' : '') + (o.italic ? '<w:i/>' : '') +
                (o.color ? `<w:color w:val="${o.color}"/>` : '') +
                (o.size ? `<w:sz w:val="${o.size}"/><w:szCs w:val="${o.size}"/>` : '') +
                (o.underline ? '<w:u w:val="single"/>' : '');
  return props ? `<w:rPr>${props}</w:rPr>` : '';
}

// A run of text; line breaks become <w:br/>
function wRun(text, o = {}) {
  const lines = String(text ?? '').split(/\r?\n/).map(l => `<w:t xml:space="preserve">${xmlEsc(l)}</w:t>`);
  return `<w:r>${wRPr(o)}${lines.join('<w:br/>')}</w:r>`;
}

// A field such as PAGEREF. Word formats an updated result like the start of the
// field code, so every run of the field carries the same properties.
function wField(instr, cached, o = {}) {
  const rPr = wRPr(o);
  return `<w:r>${rPr}<w:fldChar w:fldCharType="begin"/></w:r>` +
         `<w:r>${rPr}<w:instrText xml:space="preserve"> ${instr} </w:instrText></w:r>` +
         `<w:r>${rPr}<w:fldChar w:fldCharType="separate"/></w:r>` + wRun(cached, o) +
         `<w:r>${rPr}<w:fldChar w:fldCharType="end"/></w:r>`;
}

// Parse a WordprocessingML snippet into nodes owned by doc
function wNodes(doc, xml) {
  const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(
    `<w:frag xmlns:w="${W_NS}" xmlns:r="${R_NS}">${xml}</w:frag>`, 'application/xml');
  if (parsed.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length) throw new Error('Invalid Word XML snippet');
  return [...parsed.documentElement.childNodes].map(n => doc.importNode(n, true));
}

// Insert or replace a property element, keeping the child order Word expects
function wSetOrdered(parent, el, order) {
  const old = wKid(parent, el.localName);
  if (old) { parent.replaceChild(el, old); return el; }
  const rank = order.indexOf(el.localName);
  const next = wKids(parent).find(n => order.indexOf(n.localName) > rank);
  parent.insertBefore(el, next || null);
  return el;
}

// The w:rPr / w:pPr of a run or paragraph, created as first child if missing
function wProps(el, name) {
  let pr = wKid(el, name);
  if (!pr) { pr = el.ownerDocument.createElementNS(W_NS, 'w:' + name); el.insertBefore(pr, el.firstChild); }
  return pr;
}

const serializeXml = xml => {
  const s = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(xml);
  return s.startsWith('<?xml') ? s : '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n' + s;
};

// Put an X into the n-th "[  ]" checkbox of a paragraph. Brackets and spaces can
// sit in separate runs, so the search runs over the paragraph's joined text.
function tickBox(para, n = 0) {
  const ts = wEls(para, 't');
  const m = [...ts.map(t => t.textContent).join('').matchAll(/\[( +)\]/g)][n];
  if (!m) return false;
  const start = m.index + 1, end = start + m[1].length;
  let offset = 0, placed = false;
  for (const t of ts) {
    const s = t.textContent, from = offset;
    offset += s.length;
    if (offset <= start || from >= end) continue;
    const a = Math.max(start, from) - from, b = Math.min(end, offset) - from;
    if (placed) { t.textContent = s.slice(0, a) + s.slice(b); continue; }
    placed = true;
    const run = wUp(t, 'r');
    if (wKids(run).filter(k => k.localName !== 'rPr').length !== 1) {   // unusual run: edit the text only
      t.textContent = s.slice(0, a) + 'X' + s.slice(b);
      continue;
    }
    // Split the run so that only the X is marked: bold, in the answer colour
    [[s.slice(0, a), false], ['X', true], [s.slice(b), false]].forEach(([txt, mark]) => {
      if (!txt) return;
      const r = run.cloneNode(true);
      const rt = wKid(r, 't');
      rt.textContent = txt;
      rt.setAttributeNS(XML_NS, 'xml:space', 'preserve');
      if (mark) {
        const [b, color] = wNodes(r.ownerDocument, `<w:b/><w:color w:val="${ANSWER_COLOR}"/>`);
        wSetOrdered(wProps(r, 'rPr'), b, RPR_ORDER);
        wSetOrdered(wProps(r, 'rPr'), color, RPR_ORDER);
      }
      run.parentNode.insertBefore(r, run);
    });
    run.parentNode.removeChild(run);
  }
  return placed;
}

// Form paragraphs that received entered text (used for the page estimate)
const answeredParas = new WeakSet();

// Append entered text to a form paragraph, in the paragraph's own font size
function appendAnswer(para, text) {
  if (!text) return;
  answeredParas.add(para);
  const sizes = wEls(para, 'sz').map(s => wAttr(s, 'val'));
  const gap = /\s$/.test(wText(para)) || /^\s/.test(text) ? '' : ' ';
  wNodes(para.ownerDocument, wRun(gap + text, { size: sizes[sizes.length - 1] || '18', color: ANSWER_COLOR }))
    .forEach(n => para.appendChild(n));
}

// Mark the overall rating on the form's continuous line: the row of spaces above
// the line becomes an X on a centred tab stop at the slider position.
function markScale(para, value) {
  const doc = para.ownerDocument;
  const cell = wUp(para, 'tc'), row = wUp(cell, 'tr'), tbl = wUp(row, 'tbl');
  const grid = wKids(wKid(tbl, 'tblGrid'), 'gridCol').map(g => +wAttr(g, 'w'));
  let col = +(wAttr(wKid(wKid(row, 'trPr'), 'gridBefore'), 'val') || 0), width = 0;
  for (const c of wKids(row, 'tc')) {
    const span = +(wAttr(wKid(wKid(c, 'tcPr'), 'gridSpan'), 'val') || 1);
    if (c === cell) { width = grid.slice(col, col + span).reduce((sum, w) => sum + w, 0); break; }
    col += span;
  }
  if (width < 1000) throw new Error('Unexpected layout of the overall rating scale');
  const runs = wKids(para, 'r');
  const rPr = runs.length ? wKid(runs[0], 'rPr') : null;
  runs.forEach(r => para.removeChild(r));
  const pos = Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(value / 100 * width), 60), width - 60);
  wSetOrdered(wProps(para, 'pPr'), wNodes(doc, `<w:tabs><w:tab w:val="center" w:pos="${pos}"/></w:tabs>`)[0], PPR_ORDER);
  ['tab', 't'].forEach(kind => {
    const r = doc.createElementNS(W_NS, 'w:r');
    if (rPr) r.appendChild(rPr.cloneNode(true));
    r.appendChild(doc.createElementNS(W_NS, 'w:' + kind)).textContent = kind === 't' ? 'X' : '';
    para.appendChild(r);
  });
}

// Fill the form's document.xml in place. Throws if the form's structure is not
// what this code expects, e.g. after the Word file was edited.
function fillForm(doc, p) {
  const cfg = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const paras = wEls(doc, 'p');
  const field = id => document.getElementById(`${p}-${id}`).value.trim();
  const find = prefix => {
    const para = paras.find(x => wText(x).trimStart().startsWith(prefix));
    if (!para) throw new Error(`Form line not found: "${prefix}"`);
    return para;
  };

  // Preliminary considerations
  appendAnswer(find('State a single candidate effect modifier'), field('mod'));
  appendAnswer(find('State a single outcome and time-point'), field('outcome'));
  appendAnswer(find('State a single effect measure'), field('measure'));
  const prerando = find('Was the effect modifier measured before or at randomization');
  const pr = field('prerando');
  if (pr === 'yes') tickBox(prerando, 0);
  if (pr === 'no' || pr === 'exception') tickBox(prerando, 1);
  if (pr === 'exception') appendAnswer(prerando, '  Exception applies (see manual); assessment continued.');

  // Items: question line (may hold a "not applicable" box), option boxes, comment line
  const blocks = [];
  for (const x of paras) {
    const text = wText(x);
    const q = text.match(/^\s*(\d+)\s*(?::|Optional\b)/);
    if (q && +q[1] === blocks.length + 1 && blocks.length <= cfg.length) {
      blocks.push({ question: x, options: [], comment: null, scale: null });
    } else if (blocks.length) {
      const b = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
      if (/^\s*\[ +\]/.test(text)) b.options.push(x);
      else if (/^\s*Comment\s*:/.test(text) && !b.comment) b.comment = x;
      else if (text.length > 40 && !text.trim()) b.scale = x;
    }
  }
  const fits = blocks.length === cfg.length + 1 && blocks.every(b => b.comment) && blocks[cfg.length].scale &&
               cfg.every((item, i) => blocks[i].options.length === (item.commentPlaceholder ? 2 : 4));
  if (!fits) throw new Error('Unexpected structure of the ICEMAN form');

  cfg.forEach((item, i) => {
    const b = blocks[i], v = getVal(`${p}-q${i + 1}`);
    if (v === 'na') tickBox(b.question, 0);
    else if (v === 'dec' || v === 'inc') tickBox(b.options[v === 'dec' ? 0 : 1], 0);
    else if (v) tickBox(b.options[+v - 1], 0);
    appendAnswer(b.comment, document.getElementById(`${p}-q${i + 1}c`).value.trim());
  });
  const overall = blocks[cfg.length];
  markScale(overall.scale, +document.getElementById(`${p}-scale`).value);
  appendAnswer(overall.comment, field('overallc'));
  wSetOrdered(wProps(overall.comment, 'pPr'), wNodes(doc, '<w:spacing w:after="120"/>')[0], PPR_ORDER);
}

// The forms print "page/2" with a typed total; make the total a live NUMPAGES field
function livePageTotal(footer) {
  const ts = wEls(footer, 't');
  for (let i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) {
    const s = ts[i].textContent;
    let run = null;
    if (/^.*\/\s*\d+\s*$/.test(s)) {
      ts[i].textContent = s.replace(/\d+\s*$/, '');
      run = wUp(ts[i], 'r');
    } else if (/\/\s*$/.test(s) && /^\s*\d+\s*$/.test(ts[i + 1]?.textContent ?? '')) {
      run = wUp(ts[i], 'r');
      const typed = wUp(ts[i + 1], 'r');
      typed.parentNode.removeChild(typed);
    }
    if (run) {
      const rPr = wKid(run, 'rPr');
      wNodes(footer, wField('NUMPAGES', '2')).reverse().forEach(n => {
        if (rPr) n.insertBefore(rPr.cloneNode(true), n.firstChild);
        run.parentNode.insertBefore(n, run.nextSibling);
      });
      return;
    }
  }
}

// Changes for the completed form: it leaves out the instructions for filling it in
// (the heading, its bullet points and the empty lines up to the form table) and the
// prompt to mark the rating line, and has a smaller title with "Version 1.1" upright
function tidyCompletedForm(doc, body) {
  let el = wKids(body, 'p').find(x => wText(x).trimStart().startsWith('Consider the following important instructions'));
  while (el && el.localName === 'p') {
    const next = el.nextElementSibling;
    body.removeChild(el);
    el = next;
  }
  const prompt = wEls(doc, 'p').find(x => wText(x).trimStart().startsWith('Place a mark on the continuous line'));
  if (prompt && wKids(prompt.parentNode, 'p').length > 1) prompt.parentNode.removeChild(prompt);

  const setSize = rPr => wNodes(doc, '<w:sz w:val="21"/><w:szCs w:val="22"/>').forEach(n => wSetOrdered(rPr, n, RPR_ORDER));
  for (const para of wKids(body, 'p')) {
    if (wText(para).trimStart().startsWith('Version')) {
      wEls(para, 'i').forEach(i => i.parentNode.removeChild(i));
      break;
    }
    const pPr = wProps(para, 'pPr');
    setSize(wKid(pPr, 'rPr') || wSetOrdered(pPr, doc.createElementNS(W_NS, 'w:rPr'), PPR_ORDER));
    wKids(para, 'r').forEach(r => setSize(wProps(r, 'rPr')));
  }
}

// Intro line naming one part of the download; the contents block links to its bookmark
function partIntroXml(text, bookmark, id, newPage = false) {
  return `<w:p><w:pPr>${newPage ? '<w:pageBreakBefore/>' : ''}` +
         `<w:spacing w:before="${newPage ? 0 : 280}" w:after="${newPage ? 120 : 280}"/></w:pPr>` +
         `<w:bookmarkStart w:id="${id}" w:name="${bookmark}"/>${wRun(text, { italic: true, size: 20 })}` +
         `<w:bookmarkEnd w:id="${id}"/></w:p>`;
}

// Credit line below the page number
function addFooterCredit(footer) {
  const root = footer.documentElement;
  let top = wUp(wEls(footer, 'instrText')[0], 'p');
  while (top && top.parentNode !== root) top = top.parentNode;
  const [credit] = wNodes(footer,
    `<w:p><w:pPr><w:jc w:val="center"/></w:pPr>${wRun(FOOTER_CREDIT, { size: 16, color: '595959' })}</w:p>`);
  root.insertBefore(credit, top ? top.nextSibling : null);
}

function addHyperlinkRel(rels, url) {
  const id = 'rIdIcemanReporting';
  const rel = rels.createElementNS(rels.documentElement.namespaceURI, 'Relationship');
  rel.setAttribute('Id', id);
  rel.setAttribute('Type', R_NS + '/hyperlink');
  rel.setAttribute('Target', url);
  rel.setAttribute('TargetMode', 'External');
  rels.documentElement.appendChild(rel);
  return id;
}

// Contents block for the top of page 1
function contentsXml(summaryPage, linkId) {
  const text = { size: 18, italic: true }, tabPos = 10400;
  const entry = (num, label, anchor, pageXml) =>
    `<w:p><w:pPr><w:tabs><w:tab w:val="right" w:leader="dot" w:pos="${tabPos}"/></w:tabs><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="20"/></w:pPr>` +
    `<w:hyperlink w:anchor="${anchor}" w:history="1">${wRun(`${num}   ${label}`, text)}</w:hyperlink>` +
    `<w:r>${wRPr(text)}<w:tab/></w:r>${wRun('page ', text)}${pageXml}</w:p>`;
  const border = ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right']
    .map(side => `<w:${side} w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="A9D0E1"/>`).join('');
  return '<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="5000" w:type="pct"/>' +
      `<w:tblBorders>${border}</w:tblBorders>` +
      '<w:tblCellMar><w:top w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="160" w:type="dxa"/>' +
      '<w:bottom w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="160" w:type="dxa"/></w:tblCellMar></w:tblPr>' +
    '<w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="10766"/></w:tblGrid>' +
    '<w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/></w:trPr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="5000" w:type="pct"/>' +
      '<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="EEF7FB"/></w:tcPr>' +
      `<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="60"/></w:pPr>${wRun(
        'This file contains two editable versions of an ICEMAN credibility assessment', { ...text, bold: true, size: 20 })}</w:p>` +
      entry('1', 'Original ICEMAN form (version 1.1)', 'ICEMAN_form', wRun('1', text)) +
      entry('2', 'Summary table', 'ICEMAN_summary', wField('PAGEREF ICEMAN_summary \\h', summaryPage, text)) +
      '<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="80" w:after="0"/></w:pPr>' +
        wRun('To combine several ICEMAN ratings (e.g., several effect modifiers, outcomes, or time-points) in one table, ' +
             'use the reporting templates on the ICEMAN website: ', text) +
        `<w:hyperlink r:id="${linkId}" w:history="1">` +
          wRun('www.iceman.help/manual/index.html#reporting', { ...text, color: '0563C1', underline: true }) +
        '</w:hyperlink></w:p>' +
    '</w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl>' +
    '<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="0"/><w:rPr><w:sz w:val="16"/></w:rPr></w:pPr></w:p>';
}

// Summary table, starting on a new page
function summaryXml(p) {
  const cfg = p === 'r' ? RCT_ITEMS : META_ITEMS;
  const field = id => document.getElementById(`${p}-${id}`).value.trim();
  const sz = 18, widths = [3700, 2900, 4166];
  const studyType = p === 'r' ? 'randomized controlled trial' : 'meta-analysis / systematic review';
  const title = `Table X. Does ${field('mod') || 'effect modifier'} modify treatment effects on ` +
                `${field('outcome') || 'outcome'} on the ${field('measure') || 'effect measure'} scale? ` +
                `ICEMAN credibility assessment for a ${studyType}`;

  const response = (item, i) => {
    const v = getVal(`${p}-q${i + 1}`);
    if (!v) return wRun(item.commentPlaceholder ? 'None' : 'Not answered', { size: sz });
    if (v === 'na') return wRun('Not applicable', { size: sz });
    const label = item.options.find(o => o.value === v)?.label ?? v;
    return wRun(`${RESPONSE_CODES[v]} ${label}`, { size: sz });
  };
  const cell = (i, runs, shade) =>
    `<w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="${widths[i]}" w:type="dxa"/>` +
    (shade ? '<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="F2F2F2"/>' : '') + '</w:tcPr>' +
    `<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="0"/></w:pPr>${runs}</w:p></w:tc>`;
  const row = (runs, header = false) =>
    `<w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/>${header ? '<w:tblHeader/>' : ''}</w:trPr>` +
    runs.map((r, i) => cell(i, r, header)).join('') + '</w:tr>';
  const text = (s, bold = false) => wRun(s, { size: sz, bold });

  const verdict = verdictFromScale(+document.getElementById(p + '-scale').value);
  const rows = [
    row(['Item', 'Response', 'Rationale'].map(s => text(s, true)), true),
    ...cfg.map((item, i) => row([
      text(`${i + 1} ${item.tableLabel}`),
      response(item, i),
      text(document.getElementById(`${p}-q${i + 1}c`).value.trim()),
    ])),
    row([text('Overall credibility', true), text(`${verdict.label}: ${verdict.sub.split(' — ')[0]}`, true),
         text(field('overallc'), true)]),
  ];
  const lines = ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH', 'insideV']
    .map(side => `<w:${side} w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:space="0" w:color="808080"/>`).join('');

  return partIntroXml('2) Summary table. Useful when space is limited, e.g., when reporting an assessment ' +
                      'as a table in the main manuscript.', 'ICEMAN_summary', 9002, true) +
    `<w:p><w:pPr><w:keepNext/><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="80"/></w:pPr>${wRun(title, { bold: true, size: 20 })}</w:p>` +
    `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="5000" w:type="pct"/><w:tblBorders>${lines}</w:tblBorders><w:tblLayout w:type="fixed"/>` +
      '<w:tblCellMar><w:top w:w="40" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/>' +
      '<w:bottom w:w="40" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/></w:tblCellMar></w:tblPr>' +
      `<w:tblGrid>${widths.map(w => `<w:gridCol w:w="${w}"/>`).join('')}</w:tblGrid>${rows.join('')}</w:tbl>` +
    `<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="80" w:after="40"/></w:pPr>${wRun(CODE_LEGEND, { size: 16 })}</w:p>`;
}

// Page on which Word starts the summary table, stored in the contents block's page
// reference. Word refreshes that field when printing or saving as PDF but shows the
// stored value on screen, so it should be right. Word keeps each row of the form
// table on one page; the estimate stacks the rows onto letter pages using the row
// heights Word gives the forms with one-line answers (points, measured in Word), plus
// one line height for every further line of entered text. Lines wrap word by word at
// the width of a full-width form cell, using Calibri's character widths. Re-measure if
// the form files change: with a different number of rows the estimate falls back to page 3.
const FORM_LAYOUT = {
  r: { firstTop: 219.75, pageTop: 38.35, pageBottom: 722.4, lineWidth: 534.05, rows: [
    17.3, 16.8, 16.85, 17.3, 16.85, 17.3, 16.8, 16.85, 46.75, 17.3, 16.85, 16.8, 58.0, 17.3, 24.75,
    24.8, 35.5, 17.3, 16.85, 16.85, 42.05, 17.3, 16.85, 16.8, 32.3, 17.3, 16.8, 17.3, 271.2] },
  m: { firstTop: 216.0, pageTop: 35.8, pageBottom: 722.4, lineWidth: 535.5, rows: [
    15.9, 15.9, 15.4, 15.45, 15.45, 15.85, 15.9, 15.45, 68.75, 15.85, 15.45, 15.45, 46.75, 15.9, 15.4,
    15.9, 35.55, 15.9, 15.4, 15.45, 46.75, 16.35, 24.8, 24.75, 46.75, 15.9, 15.45, 15.4, 57.55, 16.35,
    15.4, 15.45, 24.8, 15.85, 15.45, 15.9, 46.75, 15.9, 15.45, 15.4, 267.9] },
};
const LINE_HEIGHT = 10.2;   // points per line of 9 pt text in the form

// Calibri advance widths (1/2048 em) for ASCII 32–126; other characters count as 1000
const CALIBRI_WIDTHS = [463, 667, 821, 1020, 1038, 1464, 1397, 452, 621, 621, 1020, 1020, 511, 627, 517, 791,
  1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 1038, 548, 548, 1020, 1020, 1020, 949, 1831, 1185, 1114,
  1092, 1260, 1000, 941, 1292, 1276, 516, 653, 1064, 861, 1751, 1322, 1356, 1058, 1378, 1112, 941, 998, 1314,
  1162, 1822, 1063, 998, 959, 628, 791, 628, 1020, 1020, 596, 981, 1076, 866, 1076, 1019, 625, 964, 1076, 470,
  490, 931, 470, 1636, 1076, 1080, 1076, 1076, 714, 801, 686, 1076, 925, 1464, 887, 927, 809, 644, 943, 644, 1020];
const textWidth = (s, pt) => [...s].reduce((sum, ch) => {
  const c = ch.codePointAt(0);
  return sum + (c >= 32 && c < 127 ? CALIBRI_WIDTHS[c - 32] : 1000);
}, 0) * pt / 2048;

// Lines that text of 9 pt needs in a line of the given width, wrapping word by word
function wrappedLines(text, width) {
  const space = textWidth(' ', 9);
  let lines = 1, used = 0;
  for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
    const w = textWidth(word, 9);
    if (used && used + space + w > width) { lines += 1; used = w; }
    else used += (used ? space : 0) + w;
    while (used > width) { lines += 1; used -= width; }   // a word longer than a line
  }
  return lines;
}

// Lines a form paragraph needs: its text is split at line breaks, then wrapped
function paraLines(para, width) {
  const parts = [''];
  wEls(para, 'r').forEach(r => wKids(r).forEach(k => {
    if (k.localName === 't') parts[parts.length - 1] += k.textContent;
    else if (k.localName === 'tab') parts[parts.length - 1] += ' ';
    else if (k.localName === 'br') parts.push('');
  }));
  return parts.reduce((n, part) => n + wrappedLines(part, width), 0);
}

function estimateSummaryPage(p, formTable) {
  const layout = FORM_LAYOUT[p];
  const rows = wKids(formTable, 'tr');
  if (rows.length !== layout.rows.length) return 3;
  let page = 1, y = layout.firstTop;
  rows.forEach((tr, i) => {
    const extra = wEls(tr, 'p').filter(x => answeredParas.has(x))
      .reduce((n, x) => n + paraLines(x, layout.lineWidth) - 1, 0);
    const h = layout.rows[i] + extra * LINE_HEIGHT;
    if (y + h > layout.pageBottom && y > layout.pageTop + 1) { page += 1; y = layout.pageTop; }
    y += h;
  });
  return page + 1;
}

// Build the download: completed form + summary table, as a .docx Blob
async function buildIcemanDocx(p) {
  const JSZip = await _zipLib;
  const res = await fetch(FORM_FILES[p]);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load ${FORM_FILES[p]} (${res.status})`);
  const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const parse = async path => new DOMParser().parseFromString(await zip.file(path).async('string'), 'application/xml');

  const doc  = await parse('word/document.xml');
  const rels = await parse('word/_rels/document.xml.rels');
  const body = wKid(doc.documentElement, 'body');
  const sectPr = wKid(body, 'sectPr');
  const title = wKids(body, 'p')[0];

  fillForm(doc, p);
  tidyCompletedForm(doc, body);

  const footerId = wKids(sectPr, 'footerReference').find(f => wAttr(f, 'type') === 'default')?.getAttributeNS(R_NS, 'id');
  const footerRel = [...rels.documentElement.children].find(r => r.getAttribute('Id') === footerId);
  if (footerRel) {
    const path = 'word/' + footerRel.getAttribute('Target');
    const footer = await parse(path);
    livePageTotal(footer);
    addFooterCredit(footer);
    zip.file(path, serializeXml(footer));
  }

  // Empty paragraphs after the form could push a blank page before the summary
  for (let el = sectPr.previousElementSibling; el && el.localName === 'p' && !wText(el).trim()
       && !wEls(el, 'drawing').length; el = sectPr.previousElementSibling) {
    body.removeChild(el);
  }

  const linkId = addHyperlinkRel(rels, REPORTING_URL);
  const formTable = wKids(body, 'tbl').find(t => wText(t).includes('CREDIBILITY ASSESSMENT'));
  const summaryPage = formTable ? estimateSummaryPage(p, formTable) : 3;
  const intro = partIntroXml('1) Original ICEMAN form. Useful for maximal transparency, typically provided ' +
                             'in supplementary material.', 'ICEMAN_form', 9001);
  wNodes(doc, contentsXml(summaryPage, linkId) + intro).forEach(n => body.insertBefore(n, title));
  wNodes(doc, summaryXml(p)).forEach(n => body.insertBefore(n, sectPr));

  zip.file('word/document.xml', serializeXml(doc));
  zip.file('word/_rels/document.xml.rels', serializeXml(rels));
  return zip.generateAsync({
    type: 'blob', compression: 'DEFLATE',
    mimeType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  });
}

// Button handler: re-enables auto mode and applies the computed rating.
function applyComputedRating(p) {
  autoMode[p] = true;
  showScale(p);
  // Generate ignores possible check — only block on missing items
  const result    = computeOverallRating(p, { ignorePossible: true });
  const resultDiv = document.getElementById(p + '-algo-result');

  if (result.blocked) {
    const { missingItems } = highlightMissing(p);
    const msg = missingItems
      ? 'Cannot generate rating — please complete all core items first.'
      : result.reason;
    resultDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="algo-blocked">${msg}</div>`;
    resultDiv.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  renderRatingResult(p, result);
}

async function genDocx(p) {
  // Block 1: missing preliminary fields
  const { missingPrelim, missingItems } = highlightMissing(p);
  if (missingPrelim) {
    showModal('Preliminary information missing', 'Please complete all preliminary fields (effect modifier, measurement before or at randomization, outcome, effect measure, and the interaction p-value question) before downloading.');
    document.getElementById(`${p}-mod`)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    return;
  }

  // Block 2: missing core items
  if (missingItems) {
    showModal('Assessment items incomplete', 'Cannot generate the report — one or more core ICEMAN items have not been answered. Please complete all items.');
    return;
  }

  // Block 3: overall rating not assigned
  if (!scaleActive[p]) {
    showModal('Overall rating missing', 'Please assign an overall credibility rating before downloading. Use "Generate rating from responses" or click the scale to rate manually.');
    return;
  }

  // Block 4: prerando="no" — warn + confirm override
  if (document.getElementById(`${p}-prerando`).value === 'no') {
    const proceed = window.confirm(
      'ICEMAN applies to effect modifiers measured before or at randomization.\n\n' +
      'You indicated that the effect modifier was measured after randomization and that no exception applies. See the user manual for further instructions.\n\n' +
      'Download anyway?'
    );
    if (!proceed) return;
  }

  // Block 5: possible="no" — warn + confirm override
  if (document.getElementById(`${p}-possible`).value === 'no') {
    const proceed = window.confirm(
      'ICEMAN was developed to assess the credibility of a suggested effect modification (interaction p ≤ 0.1).\n\n' +
      'It does not apply when there is no suggestion of effect modification. Assessing the credibility of an absence of effect modification requires a different approach.\n\n' +
      'Download anyway?'
    );
    if (!proceed) return;
  }

  // Soft warning: missing justifications — highlight but proceed
  const emptyJust = highlightMissingJustifications(p);
  if (emptyJust.length > 0) {
    const first = document.getElementById(emptyJust[0]);
    first?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    const proceed = window.confirm(
      `${emptyJust.length} justification field(s) are empty.\n\nJustifications are important for making your rating transparent to readers. The highlighted fields are empty.\n\nDownload anyway?`
    );
    if (!proceed) return;
    // Clear highlights if user proceeds
    emptyJust.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove('comment-warn'));
  }

  let blob;
  try {
    blob = await buildIcemanDocx(p);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    showModal('Download failed', 'The Word file could not be created. Please try again, or let us know if the problem persists.');
    return;
  }
  const safe = s => s.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, ' ').trim();
  const outcome = safe(document.getElementById(p + '-outcome').value) || 'outcome';
  const mod     = safe(document.getElementById(p + '-mod').value)     || 'effect modifier';
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a   = document.createElement('a');
  a.href     = url;
  a.download = `ICEMAN - ${outcome} - ${mod}.docx`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function hasFormData(p) {
  const tab = document.getElementById(`tab-${p === 'r' ? 'rct' : 'meta'}`);
  if (!tab) return false;
  if ([...tab.querySelectorAll('input[type=text], textarea')].some(el => el.value.trim())) return true;
  if ([...tab.querySelectorAll('select')].some(el => el.value)) return true;
  if (tab.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')) return true;
  return false;
}

window.addEventListener('beforeunload', e => {
  if (hasFormData('r') || hasFormData('m')) e.preventDefault();
});
</script>
```
